greeting: Hello! I am calling from Samarth to see how you are doing today.
questions: How did you sleep last night?
Have you eaten today, and did you take your medicines on time?
Is anything bothering you, or is there something you would like to tell us?
followup: Last time you told us about how you were feeling. How are you feeling now?
goodbye: Thank you so much, it was lovely talking to you. Please take care. Goodbye!
retry: Sorry, I could not hear you properly. Could you please say that again?
urgent: I have heard you. I am letting your coordinator know right now and they will call you very soon. If you feel worse, please call someone at home or dial 112.
fallback: Sorry, there is a technical problem right now. Your coordinator will call you. Goodbye!
safe_fallback: Please tell your care coordinator about this. They will call you.
more: Is there anything else you would like to tell me?
